## Menu

The official menu and current prices are on https://www.tacoexpresspeabody.com/.
Categories include tacos, burritos, enchiladas, quesadillas, optional sides, fryer favorites, and beverages.
Tortilla sizes: tacos use 6-inch tortillas; burritos use 12-inch flour tortillas with both sides folded in; enchiladas use 10-inch tortillas.
Crispy Cod Tacos are three warm soft wheat tacos with generous battered cod and crisp festive slaw made with green and red cabbage, carrots, jicama, vinegar, lime and light cilantro. Tartar sauce is served on the side. $21.99 per order.
Crispy Cod Burrito is one warm soft wheat burrito filled generously with battered cod and the same festive slaw, with tartar sauce on the side. $21.99.
Cod Enchiladas are two soft tortillas filled with cod, lightly sauced and baked with Mexican-blend cheese, then finished with mango salsa, light cilantro and lime. $21.99.
Crispy Cod Quesadilla has crispy cod, melted cheese and a little pico de gallo, toasted and cut into four wedges. $21.99.
Chicken Quesadilla uses chopped chicken breast with a light smoked-paprika coating, melted cheese and a little pico. Pork Quesadilla uses lean chopped roast pork with visible fat trimmed, melted cheese and a little pico.

## Service

Pickup is available at the Taco Express Peabody counter inside Eatery 58 at Mills 58.
Delivery is available through the official DoorDash listing linked above.
